text_block_list.text:
One day, as the sun was setting
after wrapping up training with Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh.
Today's training was especially fulfilling.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —President!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove?
Whatever is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There's a bit of an issue over at the dorms,
and there is something I would like to discuss with you—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah... My apologies.
I see you were just finishing your training.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind. If anything,
I appreciate your thoughtfulness and prompt consultation."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me.
The issue is with the dormitory's infrastructure—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The emergency response is complete, but I believe a detailed
inspection led by the student council will be required soon.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
For now, I believe leaving it until tomorrow or later won't be an issue.
How would you like to proceed?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I had planned to meet with Trainer-kun
after this, but—
choice_data_list: I'll get it taken care of for you by the end of the day.
I wonder if I can help with something.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for your concern,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Since Trainer-kun put it that way, too.
I'll listen to what you have to say right after this, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll go tidy up.
Trainer, see you tomorrow.
Thanks in part to Symboli Rudolf's efforts, all of the dorm's issues were resolved that very day.

She must have been tired from training,
yet seeing her prioritize her work made me realize just how remarkable she is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I suppose...
For today, I shall accept your kind offer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove, for the sake of the students,
I want to handle this today. Will you lend me a hand?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Understood.
By helping Symboli Rudolf with her work, we were able to resolve the problem that very day.
Through this, it seemed her burden was reduced, if only a little.
